outcome: Meconium excretion into the amniotic fluid (MSAF)
cohort: N/A - This abstract provides background information rather than describing a specific study cohort.
finding: This abstract reviews factors identified in previous studies, such as prolonged labor, post-term pregnancy, maternal age, and drug abuse, as major contributors to meconium excretion into the amniotic fluid.
birth_weight: Low birth weight neonates are mentioned as a contributing factor; also refers to term and post-term pregnancies and pre-term pregnancies generally.
gest_age: Meconium production starts at 12th week of gestation; MSAF is uncommon before week 37 of gestation and increases with gestational age; MSAF rates are mentioned for pre-term, term, and post-term pregnancies.
